status.en: 17 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 23% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Erbil.
status.nb: 17 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 23 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Erbil.

summary.en: Iraq's parliament has appointed US-sanctioned Laith al-Khazali as deputy prime minister, signaling continued political influence of sanctioned figures. Iraqi authorities have publicly pledged that Iraqi territory will not be used for attacks on Saudi Arabia, while Kataib Hezbollah warned it will target hostile aircraft over Iraq. Security forces have dismantled two human-trafficking networks, rescuing newborns, and foiled a ring selling infants. ISIS activity appears to be regrouping in Iraq following the US withdrawal. The conflict recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Iraks parlament har utnevnt den US-sanksjonerte Laith al-Khazali til visepremierminister, noe som signaliserer fortsatt politisk innflytelse fra sanksjonerte personer. Iraks myndigheter har offentlig lovet at irakisk territorium ikke vil bli brukt til angrep på Saudi-Arabia, mens Kataib Hezbollah har advart om at de vil treffe fiendtlige fly over Irak. Sikkerhetsstyrker har oppløst to menneskehandelsnettverk, reddet nyfødte, og avverget et nettverk som solgte spedbarn. IS-aktivitet ser ut til å samle seg igjen i Irak etter USAs tilbaketrekning. Konflikten registrerte 396 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Iraqi conflict
background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
